visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Indoor Home/Bathroom: A woman with messy long hair pours ice into a bowl, adds water from a green bottle, and squeezes a lemon. (2) She dips her face into the cold water and then dries it with a towel. (3) She peels a banana and rubs the inside of the peel on her cheek. (4) Shower: She washes her hair and then holds up a Pantene Intensive Shot hair mask capsule. (5) She applies the cream-like mask to her wet hair, showing the texture on her fingers. (6) She blow-dries her hair, which now appears smooth and straight. (7) Studio/Home: She talks to the camera, wearing an off-shoulder top, with photos of her past dyed hair appearing as overlays. (8) Product display of the Pantene hair mask box and shampoo bottle. (9) She demonstrates the product texture on her hand, showing blue and yellow beads within the white cream. (10) Outdoor: She runs and flips her hair to show its silkiness in a park setting. (11) Gym/Park: She wears boxing gloves and exercises, demonstrating that her hair stays manageable after physical activity. (12) Kitchen: She eats the banana and drinks from a straw. (13) Bedroom: She sets alarms on her phone and goes to sleep under a blanket. (14) End screen with follow-me call to action.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @crown_du. [Subtitle]: 3:15 am, Crown Daily Routine ASMR ver. (2) [Subtitle]: 3:16 am, 3:19 am, 3:43 am, 4:35 am, 4:40 am, 4:44 am. visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main female creator throughout the routine.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian woman with long dark hair, wearing a white oversized t-shirt, white off-shoulder top, or black sports attire depending on the scene.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Modern apartment settings including a clean bathroom with glass doors, a minimalist bedroom, a kitchen with wooden counters, and a green urban park with buildings in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Transient sound of ice hitting a glass bowl, followed by the pouring of liquid and a metallic click of a bottle opener. High-frequency ASMR details. (2) Squeezing sound of a lemon rind and soft water splashes as the woman dips her face in. (3) Crisp peeling sound of a banana, followed by rhythmic rubbing sounds against skin. (4) Loud rushing water noise of a shower head. (5) Mechanical click and plastic rustle as a product capsule is opened. Muted squelching sounds of cream application. (6) High-pitched humming of a hair dryer. (7) Upbeat acoustic pop background music starts. Female narration begins with clear articulation and a friendly tone. (8) Sparkle SFX overlays when mentioning product ingredients. (9) Ambient outdoor birds chirping and low city hum in the park scene. (10) Percussive impact sounds of boxing gloves hitting a bag. (11) Digital notification and typing sounds as an alarm is set on a phone.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear -> Montage -> CTA: A daily routine sequence leads into a detailed product benefit montage, concluding with a call to action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Pantene's Intensive Shot hair mask by framing it within an 'ASMR daily routine' vlog. The video highlights the product's convenience, its skin-care grade ingredients (B5/Hyaluronic Acid), and its ability to keep hair smooth and voluminous even after outdoor activities and exercise.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal praise for the brand, and clear logo visibility throughout the narrative.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses ASMR elements in the beginning to hook the audience before transitioning into a more standard promotional vlog format.
